marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX XR Series DCD1007B Hammer Drill features a brushless motor and 11 clutch settings, delivering 2100 in-lb of torque and 38250 blows per minute. This drill has a 1/2 in keyless chuck and offers 3 speed settings, making it suitable for a range of applications. With its all-metal transmission construction and pivoting 3-position LED, this drill is designed to help you work efficiently in various environments.
